name: subagent-router
description: Seven subagent workers, a review skill and a Codex CLI bridge for Claude Code, with optional model routing by Jev, a paid classifier. Codex and Jev are off by default.

typesafe_api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafe_api_key.description: Key for the Jev routing classifier. Used only while jevEnabled is true in the plugin's config.json. Leave empty if TYPESAFE_API_KEY holds the key.
